description: This Perl module defines package metadata handling functions for a software build system, including parsing metadata files, managing external references, and exporting symbols related to package and target configuration.

methods.name: get_multiline
methods.description: Reads multiple lines from a file handle until a line starting with '@@' is encountered, optionally prefixing each line.

methods.name: confstr
methods.description: Sanitizes configuration strings by replacing certain delimiters with underscores.

methods.name: parse_package_metadata_usergroup
methods.description: Parses user/group specifications for package metadata, validating IDs and names, and filling corresponding hashes.

methods.name: parse_target_metadata
methods.description: Parses target metadata from a file, extracting information such as target name, architecture, features, dependencies, profiles, and subtargets.

methods.name: clear_packages
methods.description: Clears internal hashes and arrays related to package metadata, resetting the parser state.

methods.name: parse_package_metadata
methods.description: Parses detailed package metadata from a file, populating global hashes with package, source, dependency, and categorization information.

methods.name: parse_package_manifest_metadata
methods.description: Parses package manifest metadata files, extracting package properties such as version, dependencies, source, size, and identifiers.
